topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: They say Olaf's barn holds more than just hay, that gold and silver lie hidden beneath the thatch. Who would've thought it? All these years, we've watched our crops wither and the soil grow thin, while the winter chill bites at our bones. We've prayed to the saints for relief, for a hand to lift us from our struggles. Yet here stands Olaf, a pillar of strength, a secret fortress in our village. It's enough to make one question the sky and the earth, to wonder why some fields are blessed and others cursed. But what can we do? We'll till the soil and plant our seeds, as we've always done, and hope the rain falls in its due course.
